Visit note | 2025-04-09 11:00 AM | Dr. Rafiqul Islam, Cardiology | Patient: Jubayer Karim, 63, male. Mr. Karim reports experiencing an irregular fast heartbeat and getting tired easily. He mentions these symptoms started after a sleepless night travelling to Barishal. He works as a retired civil servant and lives with his family. He has no chronic comorbid conditions. On physical examination, his pulse is 122 bpm and irregular, BP is 124/77 mmHg, and weight is 85 kg. Heart sounds are irregular with no added sounds. Assessment: Atrial fibrillation. Plan: a prescription was issued. Advice given to limit tea and coffee, avoid alcohol, and report any fainting at once. Follow-up is scheduled in 2 weeks with an ECG and kidney function tests.

Visit note | 2025-04-09 11:00 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Mahbub Ahmed, 41, male. Mr. Ahmed attends for a review regarding his ongoing bloating and symptoms that become worse with stress. He works as a farmer and notes that his discomfort flares on long commutes through traffic in Chattogram. He has a known history of Essential hypertension. On examination, his pain score is 3/10, BP reads 146/96 mmHg, pulse is 86 bpm, and weight is 83 kg. Abdomen is soft with mild tenderness in the lower quadrants. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-04-09 11:00 AM | Dr. Towhid Alam, ENT | Patient: Hafsa Majumder, 29, female. Mrs. Majumder presents with swollen glands in the neck, painful swallowing, and a sore throat. Visit note | 2025-04-09 11:00 AM | Dr. Ishrat Jahan, Psychiatry | Patient: Hafsa Haque, 55, female. On assessment, her Insomnia Severity Index score is 19, BP is 130/75 mmHg, pulse is 88 bpm, and weight is 91 kg. Assessment: Chronic insomnia. Plan: a prescription was issued. Visit note | 2025-04-09 11:30 AM | Dr. Mahbuba Rahman, Psychiatry | Patient: Ibrahim Gazi, 53, male. Mr. Gazi returns for a follow-up visit, describing poor sleep and no interest in usual activities. On evaluation, his PHQ-9 score is 17, BP is 127/73 mmHg, pulse is 72 bpm, and weight is 69 kg. Assessment: Depressive episode. Plan: a prescription was issued.
